orientation.programme_question: Can Commodity find a defensible natural-gas edge without changing rules after seeing results?
orientation.where_this_fits: Reopening decision after the strongest positive diagnostic observation was followed by two nuisance-only power failures before protected confirmation.

gap: Volatility remains scientifically plausible but the tested daily and five-session designs cannot detect the frozen 5% QLIKE MEPI. Define a material, quantitative reopening standard without adaptive outcome search.

zoom_in.reason: Volatility is the programme's strongest positive diagnostic observation, but both governed successor designs stopped on nuisance-only power. The highest-value next action is to determine what would have to change materially before another experiment is justified.

mechanism: Natural-gas volatility is persistent and responds to fundamental information shocks. A successor is justified only if a mechanism-specific design changes the independent-information or nuisance-variance structure enough to detect an economically useful QLIKE improvement, not merely because HAR persistence was diagnostic-positive.

hypotheses.h0: No currently identified material redesign can detect a 5% QLIKE improvement across predeclared dependence sensitivities while preserving fresh confirmation.
hypotheses.h1: At least one material redesign has a nuisance-only detectable effect at or below 5% QLIKE across all predeclared dependence sensitivities and preserves a genuinely independent confirmation path.

expected: A credible reopening should add genuinely independent information or isolate a mechanism-specific event population rather than merely re-aggregate the same calendar outcomes.

Persistence can make HAR-style forecasting plausible while simultaneously reducing effective independent information, so nuisance-only dependence sensitivities must clear the MEPI before confirmation.

Event conditioning tied to ex-ante fundamental information can be scientifically distinct, but it must lower nuisance variance or increase independent event count enough to clear the frozen 5% QLIKE MEPI.
disconfirming: The same daily design requires an implausibly large history under the already observed nuisance scale to detect a 5% QLIKE improvement across all dependence sensitivities.
The non-overlapping five-session event redesign still requires thousands of independent events under its observed nuisance scale.
A proposed successor differs only by horizon, model complexity, relabeling calendar rows, or reuse of consumed outcomes rather than by mechanism or independent-information structure.
No fresh confirmation path remains after accounting for the consumed diagnostic lineage and prior adaptive design choices.

mepi.rule: Do not lower the 5% MEPI to rescue power; any future different MEPI requires new economic justification frozen before outcome inspection.

same_daily_history_extension.interpretation: More history could be material in principle, but the current nuisance scale requires about 33,710 scored daily rows at the binding 60-session sensitivity. Existing admissible history is nowhere near that scale.

five_session_nonoverlap_extension.interpretation: The non-overlapping redesign improves independence but remains information-limited; thousands of genuinely independent events would be required under the measured nuisance scale.

mechanism_specific_event_population.pass_rule: A newly justified event mechanism must either supply more independent events or lower nuisance scale enough that relative MDE <= 0.05 for every frozen dependence sensitivity, before target performance is inspected.

economically_distinct_target_or_informat.pass_rule: Freeze the new economic hypothesis and target meaning first; retain 5% QLIKE MEPI if QLIKE remains comparable, otherwise freeze a new economically justified MEPI before nuisance or outcome inspection; then require all nuisance-only MDE sensitivities <= that MEPI and a fresh confirmation path.

rejected_adaptive_variants: third nearby 1-day/5-day/weekly horizon redesign without a separately motivated mechanism
additional model complexity or model-family sweep against consumed volatility outcomes
calendar relabeling that does not increase independent information
reuse of the 15.55% diagnostic observation as confirmatory evidence
lowering the 5% QLIKE MEPI after observing nuisance variance

multiplicity.future_rule: Treat #195 as hypothesis-generating evidence and the #197/#205 adaptations as programme search history. Any future confirmatory candidate must predeclare its programme inference family and cannot claim the lineage as a fresh independent replication.

confirmation_capacity.rule: A reopened successor must bind an untouched confirmation allocation whose outcomes did not shape #195/#197/#203/#205/#209 or the new design.

reopening_gate.release_rule: Only create an empirical successor after a materially distinct design has max nuisance-only relative-MDE/MEPI ratio <= 1.0 across all predeclared dependence sensitivities and a fresh confirmation path is proven.

comparison.observed_vs_expected: The nuisance-only evidence matches the disconfirming side of the literature-derived expectations. HAR persistence remains plausible, but the measured dependence/noise makes both attempted designs incapable of detecting the frozen 5% QLIKE MEPI. The event redesign improved information structure but not nearly enough. No current material successor clears the reopening standard.
disconfirmers_seen: The same daily design needs about 33,710 scored rows at the binding dependence sensitivity.
The five-session event design needs about 4,351 independent events at the binding dependence sensitivity.
No presently defined redesign both clears nuisance-only power and proves fresh confirmation capacity.

external_triangulation.comparison: Independent natural-gas literature continues to support persistent, structurally changing volatility and event-linked jumps. That strengthens the case for a future mechanism-specific redesign, but it does not overturn the measured information deficit or justify another nearby model/horizon variant.

programme_conclusion: HOLD the volatility research line. Preserve #195 as the strongest positive diagnostic observation but not confirmed evidence. Reject another nearby daily/weekly/model redesign. Reopen only when a genuinely material design or information source produces nuisance-only max relative-MDE/MEPI <= 1.0 across all frozen dependence sensitivities and an untouched confirmation path is demonstrably available.

lineage.successor_reason: #195 produced a diagnostic-only 15.55% QLIKE improvement; #197/#203 and #205/#209 then failed nuisance-only 5% MEPI power gates before protected outcomes. #277 consolidates that lineage into one quantitative reopening decision rather than authorizing a third adaptive variant.
